title: Molecular mechanisms of dragon's blood in treating ulcerative colitis based on NF-kappab/NLPR3/Caspase-1 pyroptosis signaling pathway.
authors: Cai, Bilian; Qin, Xiaohua; Huang, Xiaogang; He, Xiaojin; Zhong, Huanying; Yu, Yuan; Cui, Jinzhu; Wen, Yilei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究龙血治疗溃疡性结肠炎的分子机制，涉及NF-κB/NLRP3/Caspase-1通路和分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白靶点而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To elucidate the molecular mechanism of dragon's blood (DB) in the treatment of ulcerative colitis (UC). METHODS: Bioactive metabolites of DB absorbed into the bloodstream were characterized via LC-MS. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were employed to construct a target-pathway interaction model predicting DB's therapeutic mechanism in UC. A 4% DSS-induced UC mouse model was used for experimental validation. RESULTS: DB markedly alleviated colonic injury in DSS-induced UC. A total of 255 active compounds were identified, including 6,4'-Dimethoxy-7-hydroxyisoflavone, 7-hydroxy-2-(4-methoxyphenyl) chromen-4-one, and Apigenin. Key molecular targets included NLPR3, MAPK1, TP53, HIF1A, and PTGS2. The NF-kappaB/NLPR3/Caspase-1 axis was implicated as a central pathway mediating the therapeutic effects of DB. CONCLUSION: DB acts through a multi-component, multi-target, and multi-pathway strategy. Inhibiting the NF-kappaB/NLPR3/Caspase-1 pyroptosis pathway positions NLPR3 as a viable target for DB in UC intervention.
abstract_zh: 目的：阐明龙血竭（DB）治疗溃疡性结肠炎（UC）的分子机制。方法：通过LC-MS表征DB吸收入血的生物活性代谢物。采用网络药理学和分子对接构建靶点-通路相互作用模型，预测DB治疗UC的机制。使用4% DSS诱导的UC小鼠模型进行实验验证。结果：DB显著减轻DSS诱导的UC结肠损伤。共鉴定出255种活性化合物，包括6,4'-二甲氧基-7-羟基异黄酮、7-羟基-2-(4-甲氧基苯基)色烯-4-酮和芹菜素。关键分子靶点包括NLPR3、MAPK1、TP53、HIF1A和PTGS2。NF-kappaB/NLPR3/Caspase-1轴被确定为介导DB治疗作用的核心通路。结论：DB通过多组分、多靶点、多通路策略发挥作用。抑制NF-kappaB/NLPR3/Caspase-1焦亡通路，将NLPR3定位为DB干预UC的可行靶点。
